claims.claim_summary: ILC target architecture is a directed morphogenetic hypergraph of typed epistemic nodes and n-ary relationships.
claims.implementation_route: Current Atlas uses typed nodes and mostly binary edges; first-class definition-node activation remains CDL-099/CDL-100 plus ADR-0035 runtime activation.
claims.post_rc_route: CDL-099, CDL-100, then sensitive ADR-0035 runtime activation.
claims.publication_risk_note: Safe as architectural identity if not phrased as current large-scale active hyperedge runtime.

claims.claim_summary: The normalized hypergraph Laplacian provides a structural fingerprint over graph topology.
claims.implementation_route: Use as diagnostic and measurement substrate; settlement or consensus effect requires separate authority.
claims.post_rc_route: Adversarial SIMs and CDL routing before any consensus or settlement use.
claims.publication_risk_note: Do not present spectral diagnostics as standalone security guarantees.

claims.claim_summary: Pairing content commitment with structural topology measurement can detect structural anomalies content hashes cannot detect alone.
claims.implementation_route: Keep as whitepaper/research target and diagnostic support until adversarial proofs and governance activation exist.
claims.post_rc_route: Post-RC SIM/CDL lane before use as admission, consensus, or settlement machinery.
claims.publication_risk_note: Strong as target claim; risky if described as current live public-RC consensus rule.

claims.claim_summary: Proof of Structural Knowledge asks nodes to prove knowledge of the finalized graph structure.
claims.implementation_route: Treat as research proposal, not current live protocol gate.
claims.post_rc_route: Formalize challenge parameters, tolerance, adversarial model, and verifier cost before activation.
claims.publication_risk_note: Whitepaper may describe intended primitive; operational docs must not claim PoSK is live.

claims.claim_summary: Accepted Proof of Intelligent Labor creates ECU under governed production paths.
claims.implementation_route: Fix2d must exercise node submission, review acceptance, ECU lot creation, CDL-048 conversion, ILC allocation event, and settlement-root verification.
claims.post_rc_route: Economic behavior spec and language-neutral test vectors.
claims.publication_risk_note: Do not claim public settlement before Fix2d and subsequent gates close.

claims.claim_summary: Inverted ECU/spend-to-keep describes working-credit pressure toward productive deployment.
claims.implementation_route: Design doctrine only unless converted into ratified settlement policy.
claims.post_rc_route: Post-RC economic behavior spec and CDL decision if settlement effect is desired.
claims.publication_risk_note: Must not be described as debit, slash, burn, wallet rule, or live settlement rule.

claims.claim_summary: Backward attribution would route value backward through provenance, dependency, or Merkle-Laplacian paths.
claims.implementation_route: Keep separate from inverted ECU; no current payout rule.
claims.post_rc_route: Inverse ECU/backward attribution research lane after economic behavior spec baseline.
claims.publication_risk_note: Do not conflate with spend-to-keep or temporal decay.

claims.claim_summary: Werner pressure metrics can provide local-credit pulse/pressure diagnostics.
claims.implementation_route: Indicative calculation may be allowed only as diagnostic; no settlement use without CDL authority.
claims.post_rc_route: Adversarial tests and CDL authority before eligibility, capacity, wallet, or settlement effect.
claims.publication_risk_note: No settlement use of Werner pressure metrics without ratified activation.

claims.claim_summary: Jury assignment target design separates jury formation, case assignment, sealed delivery, and public audit material.
claims.implementation_route: Fix2g covers narrow announcement/recovery. Fix2i designs switch-out privacy. Fix2j decides blind jury CDL route.
claims.post_rc_route: If not public-RC blocker, route to post-rehearsal or post-RC according to Fix2i decision label.
claims.publication_risk_note: Raw panel broadcasts are forbidden for public path; current runtime is narrower than target blind task-handle design.

claims.claim_summary: Subjective and aesthetic review lanes can evaluate taste-like or resonance-oriented work without pretending all value is objective truth.
claims.implementation_route: Keep bounded to curation, resonance, reuse, and subjective/aesthetic lanes until settlement rules are ratified.
claims.post_rc_route: Later CDL/spec for bounded subjective settlement if desired.
claims.publication_risk_note: Must not silently promote subjective verdicts into objective truth or settlement authority.

claims.claim_summary: Sidecars are typed subgraphs rooted through agent or registry receipts and ultimately traceable to Genesis.
claims.implementation_route: Use current typed binary graph fields at v0.4; defer sidecar-specific hyperedges until post-RC schema work.
claims.post_rc_route: Post-RC sidecar typed-subgraph schema, contributor registry, and SDK.
claims.publication_risk_note: Native sidecar metadata may be package-visible; public serving and third-party installability remain default-off.

claims.claim_summary: External runtime memory pools can create substrate-level dependency among nominally independent jurors.
claims.implementation_route: Fix2i designs substrate-custody and premise-divergence SIM. Fix2j may open CDL authority.
claims.post_rc_route: Substrate custody attestation, premise hashes, and cross-juror consistency checks.
claims.publication_risk_note: Engram/CXL papers support architecture premise; adversarial modification resistance is ILC threat-model inference.

claims.claim_summary: Juror independence should consider operator, model family, runtime substrate, and representational architecture.
claims.implementation_route: Record as design target; current runtime does not enforce Layer 4 representational independence.
claims.post_rc_route: Harness H2 plus CDL/ADR authority before production independence claim.
claims.publication_risk_note: Do not claim current public-RC juries enforce all four layers.

claims.claim_summary: National or sovereign AI clusters can be modeled as operator/topology domains for diversity and spectral diagnostics.
claims.implementation_route: Future GAIA-X/sovereign adapter and attestation gate; no compliance claim now.
claims.post_rc_route: Fix-H2 or later valid phase slot.
claims.publication_risk_note: No GAIA-X compliance or sovereign-cluster live claim before implementation and legal review.

claims.claim_summary: World-model or JEPA-like endpoints may provide representational diversity relative to transformer-only jurors.
claims.implementation_route: Use architecture class as diagnostic metadata until ratified.
claims.post_rc_route: Model-router and multi-model endorsement runtime after valid sequence lock.
claims.publication_risk_note: Architecture class is not a settlement or truth guarantee by itself.

claims.claim_summary: Jurors may need to attest runtime substrate custody when external memory or pooled serving affects independence.
claims.implementation_route: Fix2i designs SIM; Fix2j decides CDL scope.
claims.post_rc_route: Candidate CDL, then runtime attestation fields.
claims.publication_risk_note: No active enforcement claim today.

claims.claim_summary: Harness sidecar provides consent, capture, routing, attestation, and optional graph submission pipeline for operators.
claims.implementation_route: Local/default-off primitives exist; model-router and CLI recipes are prompt drafts until valid sequence-lock slot.
claims.post_rc_route: Fix-H1/H2/H3 after sequence-lock assignment.
claims.publication_risk_note: Harness remains PUBLIC_RC_EXCLUDE; no public submission/serving claim.

claims.claim_summary: Multiple model endpoints can co-attest output quality or premise consistency.
claims.implementation_route: Existing receipt support is local fixture; orchestration is not implemented.
claims.post_rc_route: Fix-H2 or later valid phase slot.
claims.publication_risk_note: Do not treat local co-attestation receipt as production jury independence.

claims.claim_summary: A provider-agnostic model router can select endpoints by capability, budget, and independence metadata.
claims.implementation_route: No model-router module currently exists; H1 draft specifies it.
claims.post_rc_route: Fix-H1 after valid phase slot.
claims.publication_risk_note: No provider-router runtime claim before implementation.

claims.claim_summary: Idle harness capacity could eventually feed maintenance or Werner-credit loops.
claims.implementation_route: Idle scheduler is default-off private fixture; Werner-credit module does not exist.
claims.post_rc_route: Fix-H3 with sensitive GO and production-path authority.
claims.publication_risk_note: No credit minting, maintenance lottery activation, or settlement effect.
